verdict.rationale: Canny documents centralized capture of feedback from many sources: Gong, Intercom, Slack, support, sales and review platforms, plus customers directly through its Portal. That makes it a single feedback repository. Querying it is documented only through LLM access via the MCP server, with no native in-product search described. missing for 10: explicit native search/filter documentation for the repository, explicit internal-colleague submission flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Automatically capture feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and dozens of other sources, or directly from customers on your Portal.
Autopilot captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms automatically.
Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request. Dig into top themes, ARR impact across ideas, and query your team's roadmap.
